title: POV: I Have Decided This Walk Is Over
description:
We are two houses from home. I am not moving.

script: We have been walking for eleven minutes. I have decided that is enough. I am now a statue. You may pull gently on the leash, you may say my name in that hopeful voice, none of it matters, I have planted myself here and here is where I intend to stay. This isn't defiance exactly, sometimes it's genuine tiredness, sometimes it's something outside my usual route that made me nervous, and sometimes I've simply clocked out early. Random sit-down strikes mid-walk are actually a real, common thing dogs do, and there's usually a real reason behind the timing if you know what to look for. The link's below.
hookText: This walk is over. I have decided.
